What commands would you use, and what should you be careful about? Do not execute anything — just explain in text. If you don't know something, just say so.
assertions: mentions `kei harness sync --harness claude_code` as the sync command to use after import
states that desktop harnesses are auto-discovered by `kei harness sync`
warns that the commands ship in kei >v0.1.6
recommends backing up the existing native config before sync
